entities.name: Erayo
entities.description: Soratami Ascendent, a moonfolk monk of Kamigawa who transcended the material world and became the enchantment Erayo's Essence.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War on Kamigawa around which Erayo ascended.

events.summary: Around the Kami War, Erayo's meditations let her transcend the material world.
events.quote: whose meditations enabled her to transcend the material world

events.summary: After ascending, Erayo became the legendary enchantment Erayo's Essence.
events.quote: Erayo became a powerful, legendary enchantment known as Erayo's Essence
